component.name: hoprs
component.summary: SSH terminal, SFTP and FTP/FTPS client

description.p: hoprs is a fast, native desktop client for SSH, SFTP, FTP and FTPS. Save your sites, group them into workspaces, browse local and remote files side by side, and queue transfers that resume and handle conflicts.
SSH sites open a terminal, a file browser, or both over one connection. Credentials live in the system keyring, and sites can be imported from FileZilla.
